# MouseHit <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseHit:Int32 button:Int32, device:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | In | Int32 | required | 1 for the left, 2 for the right, 3 for the middle button, 4 for the back (X1) and 5 for the forward (X2) button. |
| `device` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together. |

**Returns:** How many times the button was pressed since the last call.

## Description

Counts presses of a mouse button since the last time MouseHit asked about that button. Use it for clicks that should do one thing and not repeat while the button is held, and [MouseDown](MouseDown) for dragging.

## Differences

* Buttons 4 and 5 (the back and forward buttons) are a BlitzLLVM extension. A button number outside 1 to 5 always gives 0.
* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local clicks = 0
While Not KeyHit(1)
	If MouseHit(1) Then clicks = clicks + 1
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Left clicks: " + clicks
	Flip
Wend
```
